newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends down on U.S. dollar strength.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends down on U.S. dollar strength.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar slipped further at the close on Tuesday, reflecting the U.S. dollar's strength in overseas markets and importers' commercial demand for the American currency, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.836 against Monday's T$27.819 close. Turnover through dealers was US$173 million.
"A strong U.S. dollar overseas and routine U.S. dollar commercial demand were the main factors today," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dealers said the Taiwan dollar remained in a downtrend but they did not expect volatile movements.
"The Taiwan dollar will continue its slow depreciation trend. The market knows the central bank does not like drastic movements," the dealer said.
A range of T$27.82-85 was seen for Wednesday.
